newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle trade moderate-active $64 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle trade moderate-active $64 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderate to active, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Inquiry good, demand moderate.

Sales confirmed on 17,600 slaughter steers and 18,500 slaughter heifers Thursday. Week to date 74,700 head confirmed including 19,000 head or about 27 percent of previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 64.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 990-1125 lbs 64.00, pen few light weights 1025 lbs 63.50.
Wk to date - 74,700 last week - 83,000 last year - 61,800
